# Zymplo

> WhatsApp-native operational agent for microentrepreneurs (MEIs) in Brazil and Latin America. No app · no signup · just chat with Zy on WhatsApp to track expenses, manage cobranças (collections), emit NFS-e, and stay organized 24/7. Built with AI that operates and learns continuously.

Zymplo is a WhatsApp-first AI assistant ("Zy") for self-employed workers, freelancers, and small business owners across 14 countries (Brazil · Mexico · Argentina · Colombia · Chile · Peru · Uruguay · Paraguay · Bolivia · Costa Rica · Ecuador · Spain · United States · Portugal). Users register no account, install no app — they message Zy on WhatsApp and get automated cobranças, NFS-e emission (Brazil MEI), DAS reminders, financial tracking, and an AI secretary that handles agendamentos, reminders, and notes.

## Key facts

- **Founded**: 2026 · Delaware (Zymplo Inc.) + subsidiary Zymplo Brasil LTDA (CNPJ 66.667.634/0001-00 · Fortaleza) + Zymplo S.A. Paraguay (RUC 80170149-0)
- **Founders**: Carlos Rejala (CEO · Founder) · José Carlos Rolón (COO · Co-founder)
- **Product**: WhatsApp-native AI agent · NO app · NO signup
- **Languages**: Portuguese (pt-BR) · Spanish (es-LATAM · es-ES) · English (en-US)
- **Target users**: MEIs Brasil (18M target) + cuentapropistas LATAM
- **Markets**: 14 countries · canonical domains br.zymplo.com · mx.zymplo.com · ar.zymplo.com · co.zymplo.com · cl.zymplo.com · pe.zymplo.com · uy.zymplo.com · py.zymplo.com · bo.zymplo.com · cr.zymplo.com · ec.zymplo.com · es.zymplo.com · us.zymplo.com · zymplo.com.br (Brasil ccTLD) · zymplo.es (España ccTLD)

## Pricing (USD-pegged · R147 HYBRID v2 LIVE 2026-05-23)

- **Plan 0 Grátis** · $0/month forever · 100 messages/month · gateway viral
- **Plan 1 Starter** · $3.99/month · 500 messages hard cap · NFS-e validation · cobrança 20/mo · 10 notas
- **Plan 2 PRO** · $5.99/month · 1,500 messages hard cap · unlimited cobranças/notas · IA reminders
- **Plan 3 Zy Equipo** · $13.99/month · 3,500 messages hard cap · multi-team 5 seats · API access · priority queue · analytics dashboard · white-label · webhooks

Country-specific pricing (BRL/MXN/ARS/COP/CLP/PEN/UYU/PYG/BOB/CRC/EUR/USD) auto-converts at https://pricing.zymplo.com or https://zymplo.com/pricing.md

## Architecture

- **Channel**: WhatsApp Business (360dialog BSP · 14 country support) · NO mobile app required
- **AI Model**: Anthropic Claude Haiku 4.5 (R170 cache 81.8% hit ratio) + Voyage embeddings · DeepSeek V4 Flash post-cohort (89% cost reduction target)
- **Voice**: STT-only (audio IN · NEVER audio OUT · R149 inmutable · -94% cost vs TTS)
- **Languages**: Auto-detect via phone prefix (95% accuracy) · zero user input required (R75)
- **Country awareness**: Auto-injects local documents/régimen/moneda per user (R86 · 14 countries profiled)

## Key features (R47 SECRETARIA-ASISTENTE-INTEGRAL)

- Cobranças automáticas (collections via WhatsApp)
- NFS-e emission (Brazil MEI · 5,500+ municipalities)
- Pix detection (Pluggy bank integration · BR)
- DAS reminders (MEI tax · BRL 75.90/month)
- Agendamentos + reminders (calendar via WhatsApp)
- Multi-modal: text · audio (transcribed) · images (OCR receipts) · documents
- Universal AI knowledge (any topic · any country · real-time · R71+R74)
- Magic-link activation (≤3 taps · ≤30s · R94)

## Product facts

- WhatsApp-native: no app, no signup — works inside the chat the MEI already uses
- Electronic fiscal invoicing across LATAM (NFS-e BR, CFDI MX, SUNAT PE, AFIP AR, DIAN CO, SRI EC, AEAT ES, and more)
- Pix and local payment rails for collections
- Trilingual product surface: Portuguese, Spanish, English
- 100% R100 web-speed compliance (TTFB <100ms p95 across all country subdomains)
- BR launch cohort 2026-05-26
